question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vaccenation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is "**Vaccination**," and the word "**Vaccenation**" is incorrectly spelt.
 
• **Vaccination **is the act or process of administering a vaccine to provide immunity against a disease. (किसी बीमारी के खिलाफ प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करने के लिए टीका लगाने की क्रिया या प्रक्रिया)
 
 
• **Example**: *The government launched a vaccination campaign to protect the population from the spread of infectious diseases.*
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is essential for clear communication and understanding of the topic related to administering vaccines for disease prevention.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Treasure: **Valuable and precious possessions or wealth, often stored or kept with care. (मूल्यवान और कीमती संपत्ति या धन, जिसे अक्सर संग्रहीत या देखभाल के साथ रखा जाता है)
 
• **Consonant: **A speech sound produced by obstructing the flow of air at some point in the vocal tract; a letter of the alphabet that represents such a sound. (स्वर तंत्र में किसी बिंदु पर वायु के प्रवाह में बाधा उत्पन्न होने से उत्पन्न भाषण ध्वनि; वर्णमाला का एक अक्षर जो ऐसी ध्वनि का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है)
